# qr-scanner

This directory contains the browser runtime from
[`nimiq/qr-scanner`](https://github.com/nimiq/qr-scanner), pinned to version
1.4.2. It is generated with `npm run build:vendor` from the installed npm
package so QR decoding remains local to zeitberg and compatible with the
application's content-security policy.
